content.text: I'll read these three files completely to understand the widget's data display, layout modes, API response structure, and configuration options.

I've now read all three files completely. Here's the comprehensive analysis you requested for your competitive research:

---

## Widget Display Data & Capabilities

### Every Data Point the Widget Currently Shows Customers

**On Success (allowed zip code):**
- Heading (default: "Check Delivery Availability")
- Success message (default: "Great news! We deliver to your area.")
- **ETA** (if `showEta: true`) — e.g., "Estimated delivery: 2-3 business days"
- **Zone/Label** (if `showZone: true`) — e.g., "Zone: Manhattan"

**On Blocked (type: "blocked"):**
- Error message (default: "Sorry, we don't deliver to this area yet.")
- **Waitlist form** (if `showWaitlistOnFailure: true`) — email input + "Join Waitlist" button

**On Not Found (zip not in database):**
- Not found message (default: "This zip code was not found in our system.")
- **Waitlist form** (if `showWaitlistOnFailure: true`)

**Input UI:**
- Text input (placeholder: "Enter your zip code")
- Check button

---

## The 3 Layout Modes

| Mode | Behavior | Where It Appears |
|------|----------|------------------|
| **Inline** | Widget renders directly where block is placed in theme | Inside the section on the page |
| **Floating** | Fixed button (📍 Check Delivery) bottom-right; opens collapsible panel | Fixed position on all pages; panel collapses/closes on backdrop click or "Close" button |
| **Popup** | Trigger button in the block location; clicking opens centered modal overlay | Block anchor shows button; modal appends to body with dark overlay (27% dark); closes on escape key, backdrop click, or × button |

---

## Configuration Flags

| Flag | Default | Purpose |
|------|---------|---------|
| `showEta` | `true` | Display estimated delivery time below success message |
| `showZone` | `false` | Display zone/label name in result |
| `showWaitlistOnFailure` | `false` | Show email input + waitlist button when zip is blocked/not-found |

---

## API Response Structure (`/api/zip-check`)

### Success Response (allowed: true)
```json
{
  "allowed": true,
  "message": "Great news! We deliver to your area.",
  "eta": "2-3 business days",        // Only if showEta enabled
  "zone": "Manhattan",               // Only if showZone enabled
  "showWaitlist": false
}
```

### Blocked/Not-Found Response (allowed: false)
```json
{
  "allowed": false,
  "message": "Sorry, we don't deliver to this area yet.",
  "notFound": true                   // Only present if zip not in database
}
```

### Error Response
```json
{
  "error": "Missing shop or zip parameter"  // or Invalid JSON body / Invalid shop/zip
}
```

---

## Fields Used from Database Models

### From `ZipCode` model:
- `shop` (route key)
- `zipCode` (normalizes to uppercase)
- `type` ("allowed" or "blocked")
- `message` (override message for this specific zip)
- `eta` (estimated delivery, e.g., "2-3 business days")
- `zone` (delivery zone label)
- `isActive` (if false, treated as not-found)

### From `WidgetConfig` model:
- `showEta` (boolean)
- `showZone` (boolean)
- `showWaitlistOnFailure` (boolean)
- `heading`, `placeholder`, `buttonText` (UI text)
- `successMessage`, `errorMessage`, `notFoundMessage` (response messages)
- `primaryColor`, `successColor`, `errorColor`, `backgroundColor`, `textColor` (6 color settings)
- `position` ("inline" | "floating" | "popup")
- `borderRadius` (numeric, in px)
- `customCss` (injectable CSS)

### From `ShopSettings` model (api.zip-check only):
- `defaultBehavior` ("allow" or "block") — if zip not found AND this is "allow", treat as allowed

---

## Widget Configuration Defaults (from app.widget.tsx lines 214-232)

All 15 configurable fields:

```typescript
const DEFAULTS = {
  position: "inline",
  primaryColor: "#008060",           // Shopify green
  successColor: "#008060",           // Same green
  errorColor: "#D72C0D",             // Shopify red
  backgroundColor: "#FFFFFF",
  textColor: "#202223",              // Dark gray
  heading: "Check Delivery Availability",
  placeholder: "Enter your zip code",
  buttonText: "Check",
  successMessage: "Great news! We deliver to your area.",
  errorMessage: "Sorry, we don't deliver to this area yet.",
  notFoundMessage: "This zip code was not found in our system.",
  showEta: true,
  showZone: false,
  showWaitlistOnFailure: false,
  borderRadius: "8",
  customCss: "",
};
```

---

## What's NOT Currently Shown (Competitive Gaps)

- **Shipping cost** — not returned by API or displayed
- **Delivery date range** — only ETA text, no calendar/date picker
- **Multiple delivery options** — no speed tiers (express/standard)
- **Cutoff times** — not displayed even though `DeliveryRule` has `cutoffTime`
- **Days of week** — rules have `daysOfWeek` but not shown to customer
- **Business hours** — not available in widget
- **Real-time inventory sync** — static zip database only
- **Address-level targeting** — zip-code only, no street/city matching
- **Geolocation auto-fill** — widget doesn't geolocate customer
- **Multiple store locations** — single shop instance only

---

## Key Implementation Details

- **Metafield sync**: Widget config written to App Installation metafield (`zip_checker.widget_config`) so storefront can read it without API call
- **Caching**: Success responses cached 60 seconds (browser) + 120 seconds stale-while-revalidate
- **Input validation**: Zip length capped at 20 chars; shop domain regex validated
- **CSS injection**: Custom CSS stripped of `</style>` tags to prevent breakout
- **Waitlist**: POST to `/api/waitlist` (separate endpoint, not shown in this file)

---

This is ideal for competitive positioning — you have ETA & zone display, waitlist, three layout modes, and full color customization, but lack delivery cost visibility, speed tiers, and real-time inventory integration that competitors might offer.
